text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Appmon] trait and 1 card with the [Game] or [Invincible] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.

text_sections.label: Link Condition
text_sections.text: ＜Link＞ [Appmon] trait: Cost 1 (Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)

text_sections.label: Link Effect
text_sections.text: [When Linking] You may suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
